tickets.title: Review Financial Plan Snapshot
tickets.text: Refresh key assumptions, compare current projections to stated goals, note material changes in income, expenses, taxes, assets, liabilities, retirement timing, and education funding needs, then list planning decisions for advisor review.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up is to refresh the household plan for North Carolina residency, Asheville housing costs, revised commuting expenses, cash reserve targets, retirement savings, and Lila’s education funding assumptions by 2025-10-10.

tickets.title: Conduct Benefits Enrollment Outreach
tickets.text:
Outreach purpose: benefits enrollment support for Nora and Ellis Bramblequill.

Message outline:
1. Confirm the enrollment window or relative deadline: before the election window closes.
2. Request current benefits materials: Cloudberry Kite Analytics benefits guide, rate sheet, and portal summary.
3. Ask about expected changes: family status, health needs, dependents, employment, and cash flow.
4. Identify decisions to review: HSA or FSA, disability coverage, supplemental life insurance, and retirement contributions.
5. If contacting a benefits professional, request clarification on: plan rules, employer match, coverage effective date, and eligibility.
6. Close with next step: schedule review, upload documents, or confirm elections.

Reusable note: Do not provide final election instructions until plan documents and client priorities have been reviewed.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to review Ellis’s Cloudberry Kite Analytics benefits guide, rate sheet, and portal summary against HSA, disability coverage, supplemental life insurance, and retirement contribution choices by 2025-09-30 before the election window closes.
